high: rules.js:39-44 — spec §8 rule password\s*[=:] is narrowed to quoted values only. Probes: scan('password=hunter2')=[], scan('DB_PASSWORD=hunter2')=[], scan('password: hunter2')=[]; only quoted matches. Fixtures use only quoted forms (flag.html:5, secrets.js:4), so the miss is untested and unjustified; stage 3 triage will silently miss common config/env secrets. Add an unquoted-value rule (with a sane minimum value length) or document/test the narrowing.
medium: extract.js:171-179 — srcset parser splits on every comma; URLs/data URIs containing commas produce bogus links: 'data:image/png;base64,AAA 1x' -> http://site.test/AAA, 'https://cdn.test/a,b.png' -> https://cdn.test/a + http://site.test/b.png. Implement spec-style srcset tokenisation (commas inside data: URLs; descriptor parsing).

extract.js:274,334-341 — <base> is applied only to later links and a later <base> overrides an earlier one. HTML applies the first <base href> to the whole document: probe '<a href="before"><base href="/sub/">' resolves before to /before instead of /sub/before. SPA/head links before <base> are mis-resolved.

extract.js:396-478 — JS scanner has no regex-literal state and drops escape semantics. Probe 'var re = /<a href="([^"]+)"/g; var api = "/api/v1/users";' emits 'http://site.test/g; var api =' and misses /api/v1/users; '\u002f'/'\x2f' paths are missed; '"/api\n/x"' becomes '/apin/x'. Track regex literals (or at least quote-delimited regex bodies) and decode/retain escapes consistently.

rules.js:49 — stacktrace regex requires :line:col. Real Java 'at com.x.Y.method(Y.java:12)' and Python frame-only 'File "/app/x.py", line 3' produce no finding (header forms are caught). Add Java :line and Python File/line patterns; current test only exercises :12:3/:12:5.

norm.js:63-68,211 — userinfo is retained in keys ('GET https://u:p@h/x'), so the same resource with/without credentials gets different keys and credentials enter key/label. Strip userinfo or hash/exclude it from the canonical key (stage 3 uses keys for dedup and UI labels).
low: norm.js:39-43 — only ASCII letters are lowercased; 'HÖST.test' != 'höst.test' (test line 174 enshrines it); spec §4.1 says host lowercased. Trailing-dot host 'host.' is not canonicalised to 'host' (duplicate-node risk).

norm.js:146-187,354-376 — ';' is not treated as a query separator; '?=' yields an empty-name param '='; paramKey preserves duplicate names ('a&a') and emits 'param:<url>?' for an all-empty query. Decide whether these are intended aliases.

norm.js:263-341 — hand-rolled resolver diverges from URL parsing for backslashes and triple slashes: '///foo' -> null while browsers resolve to http://foo/; '\\foo\bar' is treated as a relative path, not a protocol-relative host; backslashes are kept in paths. Low real-world frequency but a browser/parser mismatch.

extract.js:279-315,245-264 — a literal '<' in text can swallow the following tag (probe 'text 1 < 2 <a href="/ok">' yields no link); form action="" is skipped instead of resolving to the current URL; sink dedupes by URL only, so the second tag/attr for a URL is lost (a vs img metadata).

extract.js:181-190,317-323,513-558 — unclosed quote in CSS stops scanning subsequent url()s; text inside <title>/<textarea> can be parsed as links; malformed/truncated documents silently drop the remainder. Low false-negative/positive risk.

rules.js:11-23 — flag bodies >200 chars are missed (500-char probe = []); empty flag{} is ignored; FLAG{...} (uppercase) is not matched while CTF is case-insensitive. These bounds are reasonable but are not stated in spec/fixtures.

tests/extract.test.js:16-22,163-174 — missing JS fixtures skip rather than fail; 20 s sleeps can stall CI; missingFixtures is never asserted; endpoints fixture lacks exact count and /api/v3 assertion. Add a fixture-count test (5 HTML + 3 JS) and make missing fixtures fail loudly.

cross-module metadata — video poster is recorded with attr 'src' (extract.js:363), losing poster semantics; out.base may be a trailing-slash directory form and must not be used as a node key without normalizeUrl; MAX_LINKS=5000 truncation is silent (extract.js:8,53); scan() offsets beyond 4 MiB refer to a truncated string while bodies store full text (rules.js:105-107).

notes: Stage-2 criterion is met: 53/53 tests pass, the 8 fixtures run, and the key pair collapses. Core is clean and dependency-free, performance is linear, entity decoding and script/comment isolation work, AWS/PEM/flag rules and maxPerRule/snippet bounds are sound. RETRY is driven by the high-severity spec gap in rules.js (password\s*[=:] without quotes is missing and the fixtures only exercise quoted values) plus medium extractor defects: srcset comma/data-URI parsing, <base> ordering, JS regex-literal/escape handling, Java/Python stack frames, and userinfo in keys. The nested.html absolute-https expectation is correct, not a weakened fixture; the prompt's 'AKIA1234567890ABCDEF is too long' premise is wrong (it is exactly 16 chars after AKIA and matches).
